entry.title: Welcome
entry.content:
This is the notes section of my site. I’ll use it for short write-ups on the projects I’m building — mostly around software, markets, and quantitative analysis — and for anything I want to think through in public.

First up on the projects page is the Portfolio Analysis Engine: a live dashboard that runs a CAPM regression on a real brokerage account to separate market exposure from genuine, benchmark-independent return. More notes to come.
